preconditions.description: The number of data centers, clients, and hours in a day are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u_j < h for u_j in u)
preconditions.description: Each data center has a valid maintenance hour within the day.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i1 <= n and 1 <= c_i2 <= n and c_i1 != c_i2 for c_i1, c_i2 in clients)
preconditions.description: Each client's data is stored in two different data centers.

postconditions.description: The number of data centers to shift is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n for x_i in shifted_centers)
postconditions.description: Each shifted data center index is within the valid range.
The number of shifted data centers matches the specified count.

postconditions.expression: all(u_c1 != u_c2 for c1, c2 in clients for u_c1, u_c2 in [(u[c1-1], u[c2-1]), (u[(c1-1+1)%h], u[(c2-1+1)%h])])
postconditions.description: After shifting, no two data centers storing the same client's data have maintenance at the same hour.
